critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext.refreshPresets() spread order at line 91-96 of /app/frontend/src/context/ThemeContext.tsx: { id, name, tabActive, ...theme.custom } — since theme.custom contains its own tabActive, the spread overrides the explicit fallback. That's correct, but the order is subtle; consider rewriting as `{ id:'custom', name:'Custom', ...theme.custom, tabActive: theme.custom.tabActive || theme.custom.accent }` to make the fallback unambiguous. Not a bug today because backend always sends tabActive.

(Minor / cosmetic, non-blocking) Reanimated v5 console warnings observed: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — emitted on every screen, not specific to this feature. Worth a sweep in a future iteration.
